engine: Local SQLite dialect parser and policy; no server required
case: Malformed SQLite script tail across editor consumers
contract: A malformed quoted tail produces a planner diagnostic and blocks whole-script execution, while the valid first statement remains selectable.
Cursor selection inside the malformed tail is refused; named parameter extraction returns only the safe-prefix parameter and retains malformed SQL.
Formatting retains the malformed tail, and local agent policy classifies it as unparseable/write and denies it with fail_closed_unparseable.
remaining: The equivalent malformed-tail consumer oracle is not yet recorded for every supported dialect.
The MySQL delimiter boundary matrix still needs cases beyond the forms already covered.
